recognize_zh: MPO 免疫染色下，骨小樑旁排成厚帶的大型細胞胞質強陽性、呈粗顆粒狀，核圓且偏位，形態像前骨髓細胞/骨髓細胞，而遠離骨小樑的區域多為 MPO 陰性小細胞、成熟分葉顆粒球稀少；符合 ELANE 先天性嚴重嗜中性球低下的前骨髓細胞階段成熟停滯。
features: MPO IHC on bone marrow trephine, higher power
Thick paratrabecular band of large MPO-positive cells with abundant coarse granular cytoplasmic staining
Positive cells have round to oval, often eccentric nuclei with visible nucleoli, resembling promyelocytes/myelocytes
Few small MPO-positive segmented neutrophils in the intertrabecular space
Intertrabecular areas composed mainly of MPO-negative small round cells (erythroid precursors/lymphocytes)
describe_en: Myeloperoxidase immunostain of the bone marrow trephine highlights an expanded paratrabecular layer of large granulocytic precursors with abundant, coarsely granular MPO-positive cytoplasm and round, eccentric nuclei, morphologically corresponding to promyelocytes and early myelocytes. Mature segmented MPO-positive neutrophils are sparse in the intertrabecular spaces, which are populated predominantly by MPO-negative small cells. This pattern indicates arrested granulocytic maturation at the promyelocyte/myelocyte stage. In a child with a pathogenic ELANE variant, findings are consistent with severe congenital neutropenia; given G-CSF exposure and risk of clonal evolution, blasts should be assessed with CD34 and cytogenetic/molecular studies.

ddx.dx: Recovering marrow after chemotherapy or G-CSF effect
ddx.vs: Regenerating marrow shows a synchronized left shift that progresses to mature neutrophils on follow-up, without persistent maturation arrest or an ELANE variant.
APL shows sheets of atypical promyelocytes with Auer rods and PML::RARA replacing the marrow, rather than a paratrabecular layer with preserved erythropoiesis.

ddx.dx: Evolution to MDS/AML in severe congenital neutropenia
ddx.vs: Would show increased CD34+ blasts, dysplasia and acquired CSF3R/RUNX1 mutations or monosomy 7.
Marrow shows normal or increased granulopoiesis with maturation to band/segmented forms and antineutrophil antibodies.
